name: LG AC Smart 5 — indoor units
model: AC Smart 5 Modbus TCP indoor unit
notes: Protocol address = indoor address × 16 + point number − 1. Unit ID is Vnet number. OFFICE address 07, Unit ID 10: power writes acknowledged; mode read 1; fan write/read 3; setpoint read 22; room temperature read 26 on 2026-10-01. Fractional temperature precision is unverified. Verify controller model, firmware and supported points before enabling control. The UI's 26.5°C may differ from this integer register.

points.name: Setpoint
points.notes: Whole Celsius values: raw 22 matched UI 22.0°C. Fractional writes are deliberately unavailable.

points.name: Room temperature
points.notes: Read-only. Preserve integer source value; no invented fractional precision.
